name: Fehu
description: Elder Futhark rune "Wealth" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of common wealth such as cattle, silver and grain; as a target it is associated with Animal or Terram (domesticated animals).

name: Uruz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Auroch" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the aurochs, symbolizing strength, stamina and the wild; targets wild or magical animals (Animal) and wild weather (Auram).

name: Thurisaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Ogre" used as a vitkir Art. Negative rune meaning giant or ogre (or thorn), used for shapeshifting and against supernatural creatures (Vim) and thorny plants (Herbam).

name: Ansuz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Mouth" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the mouth and speech, associated with the Aesir and Odin; targets sounds (Imaginem), minds through speech (Mentem), and intelligent beings.

name: Raido
description: Elder Futhark rune "Riding" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of riding, journeys and travel, possibly invoking Thor; targets carts, ships, wheels and harnesses.

name: Kauno
description: Elder Futhark rune "Pain" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of torches, fever and burning pain; affects fire and heat (Ignem) as well as sores and sickness.

name: Gebo
description: Elder Futhark rune "Gift" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of gifts, generosity and obligation; targets objects given as gifts and people in the vitki's debt.

name: Wunjo
description: Elder Futhark rune "Joy" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of comfort, bliss and joy, associated with Mentem and the emotions of intelligent beings.

name: Hagalaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Hail" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of hail and the cruel side of nature, storms and missiles; associated with Auram, Aquam and missile weapons.

name: Naudiz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Need" used as a vitkir Art. Very negative rune of hardship and need; can delay or bind other rune effects.

name: Isa
description: Elder Futhark rune "Ice" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of ice, cold and cold emotions; associated with Aquam, Ignem or Mentem.

name: Jera
description: Elder Futhark rune "Year" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the harvest and year-long bounty; mostly associated with Herbam.

name: Ihwaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Yew" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the yew tree, associated with death, witchcraft, trees, bows and spirits of the dead.

name: Perth
description: Elder Futhark rune "Cup" used as a vitkir Art. Mysterious rune of fate, chance and secrets; tied to Vim, it targets vis and supernatural effects.

name: Algiz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Elk" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of protection associated with the elk; used to ward targets and increase Soak.

name: Sowilo
description: Elder Futhark rune "Sun" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of light and the sun, good over evil; part of Ignem, and can target the Divine as a subset of Vim.

name: Tiwaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Tyr" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of Tyr, truth and battle; primarily associated with Mentem and justice.

name: Berkanan
description: Elder Futhark rune "Birch" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the birch, associated with healing, fertility and youth; usually Herbam, Corpus or Animal as a target.

name: Ehwaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Horse" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the horse, mobility in combat and the bond of horse and rider; associated with Animal.

name: Mannaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Man" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of mankind and cooperation; usually linked to Corpus and used to target persons with other runes.

name: Laguz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Water" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of water, especially the ocean; almost always associated with Aquam.

name: Ingwaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Lord" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of peace, family and a secure home; targets buildings and household members.

name: Dagaz
description: Elder Futhark rune "Day" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the day, time and growth; affects aging and growth, rarely targeted as Imaginem or Ignem.

name: Othila
description: Elder Futhark rune "Inheritance" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of inherited property such as lands and heirlooms; most often tied to Terram.

name: Ac
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Oak", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Aesc
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Ash", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Yr (Futhorc)
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Bow", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Ear
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Grave", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Gar
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Spear", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Calc
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Chalk", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Cweorth
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Fire twirl", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Stan
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Stone", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Ior
description: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Water monster", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

name: Freya's Aett
description: The first aett of the Elder Futhark, named after the goddess Freya, containing Fehu through Wunjo.

name: Heimdall's Aett
description: The second aett of the Elder Futhark, named after Heimdall, containing Hagalaz through Sowilo.

name: Tyr's Aett
description: The third aett of the Elder Futhark, named after Tyr, containing Tiwaz through Othila.

name: Aett
description: A group of eight runes; the runes are organized into three aetts, usually written one per row.

name: Elder Futhark
description: The original 24-rune alphabet used by the vitkir in their earliest spells, the strongest form of rune magic.

name: Younger Futhark
description: A condensed 16-rune variant developed in Denmark and Germany; less versatile than the Elder Futhark.

name: Anglo-Saxon Futhorc
description: An expanded rune alphabet of up to 33 characters developed in England, weaker than the Elder Futhark.

name: Anglo-Saxon Rune Poem
description: Rune poem describing the runes, e.g. Kauno as a torch and Perth as a gaming piece; later edited by monks.

name: Rune Casting Variations
description: Modifiers to rune casting such as hidden or no name, hidden or no description, extra effort, emphasis and vis (Makt).

name: Makt
description: Vis as used in vitkir rune casting, adding +2 per pawn to the casting.

name: Method I
description: Rune spell method in which the runemaster names himself as the subject, typically affecting the vitki or an object tied to him.

name: Method II
description: Rune spell method in which the runemaster is named in the third person, typically affecting others or an area around the runes.

name: Rune Magic
description: The Ability vitkir use to cast rune spells.

name: Vitkir
description: Norse rune wizards (singular vitki) who work magic by carving runes; considered by many magi to be the Order of Odin.

name: Vitki (Virtue)
description: The Virtue granting a character the vitkir rune magic tradition.

name: Order of Odin
description: Name many magi use for the vitkir; the Order of Hermes has been at war with it since the ninth century.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi, generally considered at war with the Order of Odin.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: The Hermetic House a vitki might join after swearing the Oath.

name: Hermetic Rune Magic
description: A potential Hermetic integration of vitkir magic as a Major Breakthrough, giving a Rune Duration and Inscription Target.

name: Rune Duration
description: A new Hermetic Duration from integrating rune magic, working like Ring but not requiring penetration.

name: Inscription Target
description: A new Hermetic Target from integrating rune magic, working like Circle but not requiring penetration.

name: Major Breakthrough
description: Level of Hermetic research needed to convert vitkir runes into Hermetic Virtues.

name: Odin's Sacrifice
description: A vitkir initiation; magi who undergo it may receive an automatic Discovery toward Hermetic Rune Magic.

name: Oath of Hermes
description: The Oath a vitki would swear to join the Order of Hermes.

name: Damhan-Alladh
description: Figure whose war centuries ago eliminated the vitkir from the British Isles.

name: Odin
description: Father of the Norse gods, who first discovered the power of the runes; symbolized by Ansuz.

name: Freya
description: Norse goddess of love, marriage and fertility, for whom the first aett is named.

name: Heimdall
description: Norse god who guards the rainbow bridge to Asgard; the second aett is named for him.

name: Tyr
description: Norse god of justice, truth and battle who sacrificed his hand to bind the Fenris wolf; Tiwaz is his rune.

name: Thor
description: Norse god of thunder who rode a great chariot and wielded Mjollnir.

name: Aesir
description: The Norse gods, associated with the rune Ansuz.

name: Asgard
description: Home of the Norse gods, reached by the rainbow bridge Heimdall guards.

name: Mjollnir
description: Thor's great hammer, said to bear the Hagalaz rune on its crosspiece.

name: Fenris wolf
description: Wolf to which Tyr sacrificed his hand so it could be bound.

name: Aurochs
description: Large, powerful wild cattle of Scandinavia, symbol of Uruz; can be summoned by rune spells.

name: Alfar
description: Beings referenced in the rune spell for sensing vis.

name: Julius Caesar
description: Roman who described the aurochs as slightly smaller than an elephant.

name: Eirik Svennson
description: 29-year-old Norwegian warrior vitki serving the king of Norway under his uncle Sven Svennson, a member of the birkebeiners stationed near Trondheim.

name: Sven Svennson
description: Powerful Norwegian duke, uncle of Eirik Svennson, who placed soldiers and builders under his authority.

name: Birkebeiners
description: Norwegian political group ('birchfeet') that supported the northern kings in forty years of civil war.

name: Trondheim
description: Norwegian city, future capital, where Eirik Svennson's unit rebuilds defenses.

name: Norway
description: Kingdom whose king Eirik Svennson serves.

name: Scandinavia
description: Northern region home to the vitkir and the aurochs.

name: North Sea
description: Sea on whose shores the vitkir settled, causing their alphabet to change.

name: England
description: Where vitkir and Norse settlers expanded the runes into the Futhorc.

name: British Isles
description: Region where no vitkir remain in the 1200s after the war against Damhan-Alladh.

name: Denmark
description: Where the Younger Futhark developed.

name: Germany
description: Where the Younger Futhark developed.

name: Sigrunar
description: Victory runes; Eirik Svennson's Major Rune Focus.

name: Major Rune Focus
description: Virtue giving a vitki a focus in a category of rune magic, e.g. Sigrunar.

name: Fast Caster
description: Virtue possessed by Eirik Svennson.

name: Puissant Othila
description: Puissant Art Virtue for the Othila rune, giving Eirik a +2 bonus.

name: Natt-thel Prone
description: Flaw of Eirik Svennson, a vitkir susceptibility.

name: Susceptibility to Divine Power
description: Flaw of Eirik Svennson.

name: The Gift
description: Supernatural talent whose negative social effects vitkir suffer and partly offset with Gebo and Ehwaz runes.

name: True Friend
description: Virtue compared to the trust and loyalty bonus from Ehwaz.

name: Large
description: Virtue effectively gained via the Dagaz spell of giants (+1 Size).

name: Second Sight
description: Ability to perceive illusions and invisible things; several rune effects mimic it.

name: Craft: Runes
description: Craft Ability for carving runes.

name: Old Norse
description: Language Ability, used for writing runes.

name: Norse
description: Language Ability of Eirik Svennson.

name: Leadership
description: Ability to lead groups; rune magic can make untrained men act as a trained group.

name: Single Weapon
description: Martial Ability of Eirik Svennson (long sword).

name: Brawl
description: Martial Ability of Eirik Svennson.

name: Carouse
description: Ability of Eirik Svennson.

name: Folk Ken
description: Social Ability boosted by Fehu and Raido effects.

name: Bargain
description: Business Ability boosted by Fehu effects.

name: Awareness
description: Ability used when searching for treasure.

name: Area Lore
description: Ability used while traveling, boosted by Raido.

name: Ride
description: Ability used while traveling, boosted by Raido.

name: Charm
description: Social Ability boosted by Raido while traveling.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Form; Ansuz and Dagaz targets count as Imaginem for Penetration.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form of mind, associated with Ansuz, Gebo, Isa, Tiwaz, Wunjo and Naudiz.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form of the human body, associated with Mannaz, Berkanan and Ingwaz.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form of magic, associated with Perth, Thurisaz and Sowilo.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Form of plants, associated with Berkanan, Jera and Ihwaz.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Form of animals, associated with Ehwaz, Uruz and Fehu.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form of earth, associated with Othila, Fehu and Ingwaz.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form of air and weather, associated with Hagalaz and Uruz.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form of water, associated with Laguz, Isa and Hagalaz.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form of fire, associated with Kauno, Sowilo and Dagaz.

name: Magic
description: Supernatural realm; Perth is used to affect it and sense its auras.

name: Faerie
description: Supernatural realm whose auras Perth can sense.

name: Divine
description: Realm targeted by Sowilo, which can sense Divine auras.

name: Infernal
description: Realm whose auras Sowilo can sense; Thurisaz targets infernal beings.

name: Penetration
description: Rule by which rune effects must overcome Magic Resistance, using an associated Hermetic Form.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that rune effects must Penetrate.

name: Might
description: Supernatural power score of creatures, which runes like Thurisaz can reduce.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A link to a target incorporated into rune scripts, e.g. blood on a spear or an ox's horn.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power; Perth can target and sense it.

name: Warping
description: Continuous rune effects give Warping Points.

name: Confidence
description: Confidence Score and Points, which Naudiz and Tiwaz effects can reduce or boost.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural auras (Magic, Faerie, Divine, Infernal) that runes can sense.

name: Regio
description: Supernatural regions that Sowilo can see through.

name: Consecrated ground
description: Ground protected against Ihwaz corpse-animation and speaking with the dead.

name: Aging
description: Aging rolls affected by Dagaz runes.

name: Nightwalkers
description: Hedge tradition recorded in Classical Greek and later sources; troupes are encouraged to blend regional variants.

name: Folk Witches
description: Hedge tradition covered in Hedge Magic (sources listed).

name: Gruagachan
description: Hedge tradition covered in Hedge Magic (sources listed).

name: Learned Magicians
description: Hedge tradition covered in Hedge Magic (sources listed).

name: Loch Leglean Tribunal
description: Tribunal referenced by the source 'Lion of the North'.

name: Alu
description: Word used in rune spells meaning 'protect me', perhaps referring to Algiz.

name: I, the Runemaster, Speak with Odin's Voice
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ansuz General, Method I: bonus to communication Ability rolls equal to magnitude.

name: I, the Runemaster, Give Understanding of the Hollow Voices
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ansuz General, Method I: target hears spirits and distinguishes illusory noises as if with Second Sight.

name: The Runemaster Curses the Wound with Blood He Spilled
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Berkanan (Mannaz) General, Method II: penalty to recovery rolls of the person whose blood is on the spear.

name: I, the Runemaster, Carve Runes to Close the Flesh
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Berkanan 20, Method I: heals a Light Wound, permanent if the amulet lasts a week.

name: I, the Runemaster, Carve the Runes of Giants
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Dagaz 20, Method I: the vitki grows with the sun, up to Size +2 at noon.

name: The Runemaster Curses with Years the Defilers of the Grave
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Dagaz (Mannaz) 30, Method II: grave disturbers age five years.

name: The Runemaster Speaks of Friendship Among Men
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ehwaz (Ansuz) General, Method II: listeners feel trust and goodwill toward the target.

name: The Runemaster Tames the Wild Stallion
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ehwaz 20, Method II: a horse becomes well-disposed to the vitki.

name: I, the Runemaster, Ask for Freya's Blessing
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Fehu General, Method I: bonus to rolls in the pursuit of wealth.

name: The Runemaster Summons a Hearty Ox
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Fehu 35, Method II: summons (and if needed revives) a specific ox via Arcane Connection.

name: I, the Runemaster, Am Thrice Blessed
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Gebo 15, Method I: +3 to meeting and influencing others, offsetting The Gift.

name: The Runemaster Gives the Gift of Obligation
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Gebo 30, Method II: the wearer of runed jewelry defers to the vitki.

name: I, the Runemaster, Dedicate Helmet-Destroying Hail
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Hagalaz General, Method I: weapon Damage bonus equal to magnitude.

name: The Runemaster Summons Thor's Lightning and Thunder
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Hagalaz 15, Method II: raises a terrible thunderstorm around the runes.

name: The Runemaster Binds the Beasts in Place
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Isa (Fehu) 20, Method II: holds a herd of domesticated animals motionless.

name: The Runemaster Carves the Ice of the North
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Isa 25, Method II: creates a slippery sheet of ice ten paces across.

name: I, the Runemaster, Bless the Work
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Jera General, Method I: bonus to year-long activities such as study or harvest.

name: I, the Runemaster, Bless the Fields
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Jera 5, Method I: buried runed stone ensures a healthy, disease-resistant harvest.

name: I, the Runemaster, See Through the Darkness
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Kauno General, Method I: bonus to eyesight rolls, improving night vision.

name: The Runemaster Causes Fiery Fever to Burn Bright
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Kauno (Mannaz) 30, Method II: afflicts a serious illness that cannot recover.

name: I, the Runemaster, Kiss the Treacherous Deep
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Laguz 20, Method I: the vitki breathes in water.

name: I, the Runemaster, Tame the Wild Waves
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Laguz 25, Method I: a ship travels at double speed.

name: I, the Runemaster, Make Men Sure and Steady
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Mannaz 30, Method I: increases Dexterity by 1, to no higher than 0.

name: The Runemaster Leads Men to Greatness
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Mannaz 20, Method II: fighters within ten paces function as a trained group.

name: I, the Runemaster, Store Power for My Time of Need
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Naudiz General, Method I: binds another rune spell to trigger under set conditions.

name: The Runemaster Brings Hardship to the Enemy and His Family
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Naudiz (Ingwaz) 20, Method II: residents of a structure lose 1 Confidence.

name: I, the Runemaster, Feel My Hearth and Home
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ingwaz 20, Method I: sense the direction, distance and mood of family.

name: The Runemaster Calls His Children to His Side
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ingwaz 35, Method II: transports a family member to the runes.

name: I, the Runemaster, Sharpen My Axe
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Othila General, Method I: bonus to Initiative, Attack and Damage with a particular weapon.

name: The Runemaster Has Need of an Arrow
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Othila (Hagalaz) 20, Method II: summons an arrow to which the vitki has an Arcane Connection.

name: The Runemaster Defies His Rival and Laughs at His Misfortune
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Perth (Mannaz) General, Method II: adds botch dice to a rival rune wizard.

name: I, the Runemaster, Sense the Sleeping Alfar
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Perth 20, Method I: sense and identify vis within ten paces.

name: I, the Runemaster, Hear the Thunder of the North
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Raido 20, Method I: sense which way is north.

name: I, the Runemaster, Give Eight Legs to My Horse
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Raido 30, Method I: the horse covers ten paces per step.

name: I, the Runemaster, Step Most Surely in Sunlight
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Sowilo General, Method I: bonus to Perception-based rolls.

name: I, the Runemaster, Summon Summer's Brightness
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Sowilo 25, Method I: bright sunlight shines from the target, driving off creatures of the night.

name: I, the Runemaster, Fight for My Companions
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Tiwaz General, Method I: bonus to Attack rolls in battle.

name: I, the Runemaster, Can Sense the Liar's Craft
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Tiwaz 30, Method I: sense whether people believe they tell the truth.

name: The Runemaster Prepares the Ogre-Slaying Spear
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Thurisaz General, Method II: reduces Might of supernatural creatures near the spear's path.

name: I, the Runemaster, Call the Serpent from the Brambles
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Thurisaz 30, Method I: turns a twisted branch into a venomous snake.

name: I, the Runemaster, Need Strength for My Trials
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Uruz General, Method I: bonus to Strength-based rolls.

name: I, the Runemaster, Summon the Aurochs
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Uruz 45, Method II: summons an uncontrolled aurochs.

name: The Runemaster Gives the Gift of Joy
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Wunjo (Gebo) 20, Method II: a gift is received with joy and gratitude.

name: I, the Runemaster, Paint the Runes of Frenzy
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Wunjo 30, Method I: a warrior ignores Fatigue and Wound Penalties.

name: I, the Runemaster, Walk Swiftly Through the Murky Wood
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ihwaz 15, Method I: intuitive sense of trees for forest travel.

name: I, the Runemaster, May Speak with the Shades of the Past
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ihwaz 35, Method I: communicate with the spirits of a grave.

name: I, the Runemaster, Protect Against Beings of Fire and Pain
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Algiz (Kauno) General, Method II: wards fire creatures and disease spirits.

name: The Runemaster Protects Against the Beasts of the Wild
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Algiz (Uruz) 10, Method II: wild animals cannot approach within ten paces.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Bound This Wound
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Berkanan 15, Method I script: +9 to recovery rolls from combat injuries.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Will Work Well This Day
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Dagaz 15, Method I script: +3 to all-day activities.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Strengthen the Sword of My Ancestors
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Othila 25, Method I script: +5 Initiative, Attack and Defense with his inherited sword.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Invoke Tyr's Power
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Tiwaz 25, Method I script: +5 to Attack rolls.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Invoke Tyr's Cunning
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Tiwaz 25, Method I script: +5 to Defense rolls.

name: I, Eirik Svennson, Call My Helmet Alu
description: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Algiz 25, Method I script: +5 to Soak via his helmet.
